y04.epoch_convention: 1-based; logged lr[e] is read after the end-of-epoch callbacks, so the first epoch with a lower lr is the epoch whose end fired the cut; the smaller rate first trains epoch e+1

x00_eg_seed0.note: train_loss is Keras' running mean over the epoch with dropout ON, so it sits above val_loss (dropout OFF)
